title: Two-to-four inequality from nonnegative functions
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and suppose that every pointwise nonnegative function $g:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfies $\|T_{1/\sqrt{3}}g\|_4\leq\|g\|_2$. Then every real-valued function $f$ on $\{\pm1\}^n$ satisfies $\|T_{1/\sqrt{3}}f\|_4\leq\|f\|_2$, with norms taken with respect to uniform measure on the cube.
hypotheses_covered: The stated norm inequality holds for every pointwise nonnegative $g:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$
